dish.note: Stewed Granny Smiths under a buttery oat crumble, hot custard poured over.
dish.how: Heat the oven to 180C. Peel, core and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and stew with 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp water for 10 minutes. Tip into a baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 100g plain flour, then stir in 60g rolled oats and 80g brown sugar and scatter over the apples. Bake 30 minutes until golden and serve hot with 600ml warm custard.
dish.make_ahead: Stew the apples and rub the crumble up to 1 day ahead; bake on the night

steps.text: Peel, core and slice the apples.
Stew the apples with the sugar, cinnamon and a splash of water.
Rub the butter into the flour, stir in the oats and brown sugar and scatter over the apples.
Bake at 180C until golden, then serve hot with warm custard.
